description: This source file defines a setup fixture for the Allure reporting framework within a test suite using NUnit. It manages the initialization and cleanup of Allure result directories and provides fallbacks to ensure minimal reporting even if the main adapter is not active.

classes.name: AllureSetup
classes.description: A setup fixture class that configures and cleans up Allure report results directory for NUnit tests.

methods.name: ResolveResultsDir
methods.description: Determines the directory path where Allure results should be stored, using environment variables, test parameters, or defaulting to '../allure-results'.

methods.name: GlobalSetup
methods.description: Executes once before any tests run to create the results directory, set environment variables, and clean up existing results.

methods.name: GlobalTearDown
methods.description: Executes after tests to write minimal Allure results, ensuring at least one result JSON is present.
